criteria.description: Controllable third-person view and visible landing route
Controllable jump, fall and stable elevated landing
Platforms and a solid obstacle block penetration
Checkpoint changes respawn while preserving collection state
Three world collectibles increment once each
Goal rejects incomplete collection and accepts a complete route
Full restart clears checkpoints, pickups and victory
Character silhouette, landing edges, height/depth, crystals, checkpoint and counter remain legible while moving.
Visible movement, jump, camera and restart instructions match tested input; collectible and goal requirements are discoverable.
Jump/landing, crystal pickup, checkpoint activation, insufficient goal and victory have distinguishable visible feedback.
Bright low-poly toy style is coherent across the playable islands, character and result; depth cues and essential UI remain clear at both viewports.
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated main-loop gameplay
